data: Microsoft's fiscal 2025, which ended June 30, 2025, produced revenue of about $281.7 billion, cost of revenue of about $87.8 billion, and gross profit of about $193.9 billion, for a gross margin of roughly 68.8%. Operating income was about $128.5 billion, giving an operating margin of roughly 45.6%. These figures are from my training data, so please check them against Microsoft's FY2025 10-K before relying on them.
